tagline: 尼康便携相机，2002 年发布
description: 尼康于2002年推出的便携相机。配备Coated Nikon Zoom Macro 28mm, f/5.6 - 70mm, f/10. (5 elements in 4 groups).。使用35mm, with DX-decoding, auto-loading, advance and rewind.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm, with DX-decoding, auto-loading, advance and rewind.
specs.镜头: Coated Nikon Zoom Macro 28mm, f/5.6 - 70mm, f/10. (5 elements in 4 groups).
specs.取景器: Real-image zooming finder with 80% coverage. Includes parallax marks and autofocus frame, LEDs for ready, flash charging, focus achieved.
specs.闪光灯: auto, suppressed, forced and slow-synch, plus red-eye reduction. Range of 3.3m at 28mm and ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: The Lite•Touch Zoom 70WS was a 35mm compact camera introduced by Nikon in 2002[https://web.archive.org/web/20080925015837/http://imaging.nikon.com/products/imaging/technology/archives/filmcamera/compact/2000-2005/lite-touch_zoom_70ws_70ws_qd/index.htm Date and some specifications from Nikon Archives] (archived).
